name: Eval Dashboard splits into Agents | Skills tabs, defaulting to Agents
description: Proves the /eval Agents|Skills split (AC-23) deterministically + LLM-free. NOTE: the tab labels 'Agents'/'Skills' also appear as left-nav items and the Sidebar renders BEFORE <main>, so neither a text nor a role click can unambiguously target the tab (the tab uses role='tab', which agent-browser does not resolve, and a text click would hit the nav link → /skills). The tab strip drives a URL param — a Skills click is router.push('/eval?tab=skills') — so this flow verifies that param contract directly: /eval defaults to the Agents view (the seeded 'Security Reviewer' renders unchanged — L06 behaviour preserved) with both tab labels visible, and /eval?tab=skills renders the Skills-view marker ('Run all skills', not present in the nav). The click→push wiring itself is covered by the RTL test client/src/app/eval/page.test.tsx. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (acme/payments-api) — guaranteed by the hermetic stack / e2e-web.yml fresh seed.
